brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster (0,0,0 + 1,0,0 + 0,1,0) with full-depth bins: 2x 3-compartment bins (0,0,0 and 0,1,0) for bobbins/buttons/notions sorting, 1x 2-compartment bin (1,0,0) for fabric/scissors; hook plates on two cells for scissors/tape measures, rod socket on third for spool/thread rod.

finish.summary: Compact 3-hex organizer: compartmented bins for small notions plus hooks and spool rod for sewing tools, verified mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
